items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: And this is Miss Brazile. She's the lady that's the head of the head on here. She's a very prominent person right here.

ctx.x: Did you see this school band in the back or how? Where?

It's his school band. I'm really yester the band that I can get to. Yeah. Look, my son was Duke last year to um, to Phillip Marrero the King. And look at him how happy he is there. Holy champagne. Holy champagne. He has to be on one more time. The past, the past, present, and the future. Yeah. Now I want you to see this. This is Mrs. Brown I believe. All these. Let's put these in. This.
